title: ATTACHED FORM NO. 2 — Certificate of Designation as a National Career Education Center
full_text:
ATTACHED FORM NO. 2 — Certificate of Designation as a National Career Education Center
[Enforcement Rule of the Career Education Act]

[FRONT]
Certificate No. __________

CERTIFICATE OF DESIGNATION AS A NATIONAL CAREER EDUCATION CENTER

1. Name of institution (organization): __________________
2. Business registration number (corporate registration number): __________________
3. Name of representative: __________________ (Date of birth: __________________)
4. Address of principal office of institution (corporation): __________________ (Telephone: __________________)
5. Address of National Career Education Center: __________________ (Telephone: __________________)
6. Designation period: ________________________________________

In accordance with Article 15 (1) of the Career Education Act and Article 3 of its Enforcement Rule, the above institution (organization) is hereby designated as a National Career Education Center.

Year: ____  Month: ____  Day: ____
Minister of Education (official seal)

Paper size: 210 mm × 297 mm; white paper, 150 g/m².

[BACK]
RECORD OF CHANGES
| Date | Details | Recorded by |
|------|---------|-------------|
| __________ | __________________ | __________ |
(Additional blank rows are provided on the original form.)
